description: Secret delivery hardening: deny agent `agro secret get` and restrict `agro secret set --sandbox` to the keys that Compose passes into the container.

userStories.title: Deny agent reads through `agro secret get`
userStories.description: As the operator, I want the agent hooks to deny `agro secret get` so that an agent cannot print a raw secret into its transcript.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/hooks/deny-env-dump.sh` returns `deny` for `agro secret get GH_TOKEN`.
The hook returns `deny` for `agro secret get SANDBOX_PASSWORD --sandbox box` and for `npx agro secret get GH_TOKEN`.
The hook returns no decision for `agro secret list` and for `agro secret set GH_TOKEN`.
The deny message tells the agent to ask the operator to run the command.
`.agro/scripts/__tests__/hooks.test.ts` holds a case for each command above, and `npx vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/hooks.test.ts` exits 0.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: AC1-3 executed: hooks.test.ts cases for get (deny x3), list and set (no decision); new cases failed before the hook change. AC4 reasoned: the shared deny message names `agro secret get` and tells the agent to ask the operator. AC5 executed on the integrated task branch: npx vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/hooks.test.ts exit 0 (138 passed). AC6 executed by the worker: npm run typecheck exit 0.

userStories.title: Restrict `agro secret set --sandbox` to the keys that Compose passes
userStories.description: As the operator, I want `agro secret set <KEY> --sandbox <name>` to refuse a key that never reaches the container so that a stored secret never fails silently.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/cli/src/lib/secrets.ts` exports `COMPOSE_SECRET_KEYS` with the values `GH_TOKEN`, `SANDBOX_PASSWORD`, and `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`.
A test reads `.devcontainer/docker-compose.yml` and asserts that the `${KEY:-}` entries for allow-listed secret keys equal `COMPOSE_SECRET_KEYS`.
With `--sandbox <name>`, `runSecretSet` exits 1 for `PI_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` and writes no file.
The refusal message names the key and tells the operator to run `agro secret set <KEY>` in the project checkout.
With `--sandbox <name>`, `runSecretSet` exits 0 for `GH_TOKEN` and writes the entry `.env`.
Without `--sandbox`, `runSecretSet` exits 0 for `PI_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN`.
`npx vitest run .agro/cli/src/__tests__/config-secret.test.ts` exits 0.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: AC1-6 executed: secrets.test.ts and config-secret.test.ts cases (compose parity, --sandbox refusal with no file and no prompt, message names key and checkout command, GH_TOKEN with --sandbox, PI_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN without --sandbox); new cases failed before the change. AC7 executed on the integrated task branch: npx vitest run on both files exit 0 (62 passed). AC8 executed on the integrated task branch: npm run typecheck exit 0 (the worker worktree lacked root deps; pnpm install fixed it).

userStories.title: Document the delivery rule
userStories.description: As the operator, I want the docs to state which keys `--sandbox` accepts so that the docs match the CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/configuration.md` states that `--sandbox` accepts only `GH_TOKEN`, `SANDBOX_PASSWORD`, and `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`.
`docs/configuration.md` states that the container reads the other keys from the `.env` of the project checkout.
`docs/security-considerations.md` states that the hooks deny `agro secret get` for agents.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh docs/configuration.md` reports no new finding on a changed line.

userStories.title: Record manual review evidence
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a command transcript so that the PR shows the changed behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/secret-delivery-hardening/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the hook output for `agro secret get GH_TOKEN` piped through the hook as JSON input.
The file holds the output and exit code of `runSecretSet` for `PI_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` with `--sandbox` in a temporary `AGRO_HOME`.
The transcript holds no secret value.
The story deletes each temporary directory that it creates.
